title: Coverage Re-Check Allowance for Extended Imaging and Procedure Authorizations
content:
The coverage re-check allowance of the added validity on an extended Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) follows the age, on the study date, of the last coverage verification on the patient's Patient Financial Account.

## Clauses

1. Older than both the type's coverage re-verification figure and the financial class's re-verification period gives the payer re-check allowance of **5 days**.
2. Older than the type's coverage re-verification figure but within the class's re-verification period gives the internal re-check allowance of **3 days**.
3. Otherwise there is no allowance.

The type's coverage re-verification figure is 30 days for the Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization and 30 days for the Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization. The class's re-verification period is the figure of the patient's financial class on the Patient Financial Account.

## Terms

- **Age on the study date**: the calendar days from the coverage verification date recorded on the Patient Financial Account to the scheduled date of the study booked against the authorization.
- **Older than** a figure means the age is greater than it; **within** a period means the age is equal to or less than it.

## Truth table (type figure of 30 days; hypothetical class period of 60 days)

| Age on the study date | Older than 30 days | Older than the class's 60 days | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 75 days | yes | yes | 5 days |
| 60 days | yes | no (within) | 3 days |
| 31 days | yes | no (within) | 3 days |
| 30 days | no | no | none |
| 10 days | no | no | none |

With a hypothetical class period of 20 days, an age of 25 days is older than the class period but not older than the type's 30 days, so there is no allowance.
